result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: text truncation without ellipsis on restaurant names in horizontal cards, and a partially cut-off category chip at the right edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge of the screen in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section, with no visible ellipsis or fade indicator that more content exists horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability, and apply proper text truncation with ellipsis for card titles.

issues.description: A category filter chip is partially visible at the far right edge after 'Healthy', appearing cut off without a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or chevron to indicate the category row is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears slightly clipped at the bottom ('Rame' with the 'n' partially cut) in the 'Popular right now' section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient line height or container padding so the full restaurant name renders without vertical clipping.
